crossCutting.ordinaryCalculatorFlow: apps/web/src/character-calculations.ts:getCharacterDocuments maps classified skillIds to ordinary CalculatorDocuments; apps/web/src/calculator-ui.ts renders and calculates them. Formula IDs are instantiated from apps/web/src/character-source-formulas.ts. Kachina has an observed-event editor via apps/web/src/calculator-kachina-controls.ts; Alyosha has an ordered C0 lifecycle ledger via apps/web/src/calculator-alyosha-observed-controls.ts and packages/sim-core/src/alyosha-observed-lifecycle.ts. These accept actual user-entered observations and do not autonomously generate timing or attacks. Low/high observed plunge actions also enter the ordinary Calculator through apps/web/src/calculator-source-cast-controls.ts and apps/web/src/calculator-observed-plunge-controls.ts; packages/sim-core/src/observed-plunge-formulas.ts expands actual contacts and can mark complete-cast only when the required observations are supplied.
crossCutting.evidenceBoundary: Partial means the mapping does not establish a complete action/lifecycle. It does not imply the selected component formula is missing. UI defaults are editable teaching inputs, not game state evidence. Kachina event-entry UI and Alyosha C0 event-ledger UI are present; their presence does not make observed timing autonomous or remove the mapping partial classification. The eight low/high observed plunge actions are statically partial by design; runtime completion is conditional on actual contacts, explicit physical/no-infusion conditions, and stable per-hit state. Their addition is not a regression in the prior 16 actions.
crossCutting.eyeOfPerception: Separate from the 16 character partial skillIds. packages/sim-core/src/weapon-proc.ts now implements the explicit fixed-gcsim Eye automatic profile; it retains the catalogue/Optimizer coefficient/probability conflict and is source-provisional, not reconciled current-game truth.
